about: Canonical QorCap <-> QorTime contract registry. QorTime owns it; QorCap vendors a byte-identical copy (contracts/ + CONTRACTS_PIN) and its tests fail on drift. Change it here first, then re-vendor.

hash_chain.canonical_json: RFC 8785 JCS, integers only (|n| <= 2^53-1), no floats
hash_chain.signature: Ed25519 over JCS(receipt minus signatures); {key_id, sig}; key_id = 16 hex

rules: |referee_ts_ms - t_ms| <= max_skew_ms for every checkpoint, INCLUDING the last (stop) checkpoint
checkpoint_timing.stop_checkpoint: QorCap >= 0.3.3 writes a 'stop' checkpoint after finalising the video, seals the chain, and waits for the local referee (POST /countersigned) before the slow input-proof work. QorCap <= 0.3.2 had no seal: the tail was countersigned only after the bundle work, tens of seconds late -> gap_too_long + clock_skew on the last checkpoints. The verifiers are right; those recordings cannot be repaired honestly.

challenge_rules.count: one official challenge per phase per role (3); all three answered + re-verified for VERIFIED

open_at.kickoff: first pause-capable moment of the game: quarter 1+ read, game clock seen running (opening kickoff fielded), then a play-call screen came and went (pre-snap)
open_at.halftime: same, in quarter 3+ (after the second-half kickoff)

challenge_rules.why: online Madden 27 cannot pause during a kickoff or kickoff return; OPTIONS works only after a play call
challenge_rules.fallback: if no play-call screen is detected, the recorder opens the window 45 s after the game clock started running in that quarter (gate basis clock_proxy)
challenge_rules.pattern: OPTIONS then 4 face/d-pad buttons from sha256(nonce)
challenge_rules.response: first OPTIONS press inside [issued_ms, deadline_ms] followed by exactly the pattern

1.default_when: bundle.json has no challenge_rule, or result.rule is absent

2.opt_in: bundle.json challenge_rule = 2; the referee stamps result.rule = 2

challenge_rules.recorder_result: QorCap >= 0.3.11 re-runs each challenge on its own bundle at finalize; an ok result is written to the receipt (reverified_by recorder), anything else stays null with the reason in challenge_results.jsonl
challenge_rules.gate_log: challenge_gates.jsonl: one line per opened window with the gate basis and scorebug state

rules: equal scores -> tie (legacy receipts with away on a tie still verify)
last_scorebug_read_unconfirmed with no score read -> scores null, winner unknown
last_scorebug_read_unconfirmed keeps the real quarter (>= 1) or null; never forced to 4

official_referee.role: offline root (can_delegate); the service signs with a delegated online key
